name: @teactjs/redis
description: Redis storage driver, session store and plugin for Teact — ioredis, node-redis, Bun RedisClient and Upstash (edge)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/core --external @teactjs/storage --external @teactjs/plugin-sdk --external ioredis --external redis --external @upstash/redis && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/fix-dts.ts
